interpretation.text: Two local readings conflict for this row. (a) Literal CDS reading: Note (3) applies to every 1.0 in e_Sigma*, so stars row 2 carries an upper-limit marker (P53 label UPPER_LIMIT_NOTE3; bundle upper_limit_marker true; value present). (b) The secondary note reports that the primary paper's printed example (Appendix E) lists populated values with RMS 1.0, concludes that NGC 3198's populated stellar row with RMS 1.0 "is not a limit flag", and says HI limits are encoded as a blank density with 1.0 in the error slot. Schema fact relevant to both: only SigmaHI is nullable ("?", line 171); Sigma* has no "?" (line 175), so the blank-density encoding described in (b) cannot occur in the stellar column, and the ReadMe gives no other encoding for a stellar limit. The P53 freeze already records this as SEMANTIC_CONFLICT_PENDING_DISTINCT_REVIEW with Gaussian_likelihood null. Neither reading is adopted here.
